summary: Frontend-only PASS at https://smart-matrix-hub.preview.emergentagent.com (viewport 390x844). All 3 NEW review-request features and every regression PASS. (1) NEW Quiet Chime Hours: Toggling 'Alert Chime' (nearest role=switch to the label; the app has 7 switches total across screens - the Alert Chime one is at (317, ~671) after scrolling into view) writes weather.alertSound=true to localStorage 'aura_settings_v1' AND reveals the 'Quiet hours' row (via `{w.alertSound && ...}` conditional). Toggling 'Quiet hours' writes weather.quietHours.enabled=true AND reveals two HourStepper controls labeled 'From' (default 22 -> '10 PM') and 'To' (default 7 -> '7 AM'), rendered side-by-side in `nightRow` (156px wide each, 44px tall, x=33 and x=201). Both minus/plus Pressables (36x36 Ionicons remove/add) are tappable and cycle hours via (h+23)%24 and (h+1)%24 respectively. Verified: From-plus x2 + From-minus x1 = net +1 (22->23, display '11 PM'); To-plus x1 = +1 (7->8, display '8 AM'). fmtHour formats correctly (0 -> '12 AM', 12 -> '12 PM', 23 -> '11 PM'). After a FULL PAGE RELOAD, localStorage still shows {alertSound: true, quietHours: {enabled: true, startHour: 23, endHour: 8}} and the UI re-renders both the toggle-ON state and the steppers at the persisted values. (2) NEW Second Location: Scrolled to 'Second Location' SectionLabel + card containing 'A family member's ZIP' label + TextInput with placeholder 'e.g. 33101' (numeric keypad, maxLength 5). Filling '77002' calls onZip2 which strips non-digits, calls updateSecondLocation({zip}) immediately, then upon length==5 calls geocodeZip and writes {lat: 29.7594, lon: -95.3594, city: 'Houston', state: 'TX'}. Storage confirmed: weather.secondLocation = {zip:'77002', lat:29.7594, lon:-95.3594, city:'Houston', state:'TX'}. UI then renders 'Watching Houston, TX · 1 alert' line, followed by a tappable alertCard (Heat Advisory / Moderate / 'until Wed 5:00 AM' / 'Tap for details ›') with correct severity color. Persisted across full page reload (localStorage + UI restore both verified). (3) NEW Second-Location alert detail modal: Tapping the second-location alert card (last 'Tap for details' occurrence — count went from 1 to 2 after adding the second location) opens the SAME AlertDetailModal (transparent slide-up sheet from bottom) with the event title 'Heat Advisory', severity color bar (yellow/Moderate), 'Moderate · until Wed 5:00 AM' meta line, area 'Houston, Trinity +31 more', a headline paragraph 'Heat Advisory issued August 25 at 12:34PM CDT until August 26 at 7:00PM CDT by NWS Houston/Galveston TX', a 'DETAILS' section with the full NWS description ('* WHAT...Heat index values up to 108. * WHERE... * WHEN... * IMPACTS...') and a 'WHAT TO DO' section with the instruction ('Take extra precautions when outside. Wear lightweight and loose fitting clothing...OSHA recommends...'). Modal closes cleanly (verified via Escape key onRequestClose) and page continues rendering without errors. Screenshot: /tmp/wq_modal.png. (4) Clearing the second-location ZIP: setting the TextInput to '' invokes `updateSecondLocation({zip:'', lat:null, lon:null, city:'', state:''})` (see weather.tsx:170-172), storage confirms all fields empty, UI reverts to 'Add a second town to see its alerts here too.' and alert cards disappear. (5) REGRESSION Weather primary: 'Harris County, TX · Houston' county line still shows for Flights ZIP 77002; 'Active Alerts' section + Heat Advisory alert card still shows above the master toggle; clearing weather.secondLocation.lat back to null while keeping primary still shows the primary 'Active Alerts' correctly; 'Time & Temperature' toggle + 4 'Minimum Severity' radios (Minor/Moderate/Severe/Extreme) persist; 'Preview Alert on Matrix' shows exact info toast 'Connect to the matrix first (Device tab).' when disconnected. 'No active alerts' clear-state still shows for clear ZIPs (verified in iter 14/15). (6) REGRESSION overall: All 4 tabs (Device/Flights/Sports/Weather) load with no red-screen; global SYNC FAB shows an info toast ('BLE needs a real device build to sync.') when disconnected. No new deprecation warnings beyond the long-standing shadow*/pointerEvents/useNativeDriver notes carried over from iter 8-15. Non-review-related note: ADSB CORS errors on the Flights tab (api.adsb.lol) print in console but are handled — same as prior iterations.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow. Non-blocking. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/SyncFab.tsx and shared Card component.
'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' Non-blocking. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/SyncFab.tsx.
'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported on web' fires when Toast animates. Could be gated behind Platform.OS !== 'web'. Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional, repeated) Add testID props to the new Weather-tab elements listed under design_issues so tests don't rely on nearest-y switch heuristics and Pressable-child coordinate math.

(Minor, optional) In weather.tsx:98 the isQuietNow gate for chime is evaluated at the moment new alerts arrive — correct — but the `w.alertSound && ...` check inside `chimeFor` means when `alertSound` is off, seenIdsRef still gets populated (line 97). That is desired (prevents chime spam if the user toggles it back on mid-storm). Just confirming this is intentional; consider a code comment.

(Minor, optional) `updateSecondLocation({zip:''})` immediately followed by the len==0 branch clearing lat/lon runs two setState/persist calls in the same tick (weather.tsx:165 then :170). Not a bug — final persisted value is correct — but could be merged into a single updateSecondLocation call to avoid an intermediate persist.
(Repeated from iter 8-15) Migrate shadow* -> boxShadow and pointerEvents prop -> style.pointerEvents in SyncFab.tsx.
critical_code_review_comments: weather.tsx:20-26 isQuietNow correctly handles both same-day (start<end) and wraps-midnight (start>end) windows; treats startHour===endHour as 'off'. Good.
weather.tsx:28-33 fmtHour handles 0 -> '12 AM' and 12 -> '12 PM' edge cases. Correct.
weather.tsx:35-50 HourStepper uses (hour+23)%24 for decrement (equivalent to -1 with proper wrap) and (hour+1)%24 for increment. Correct wrap behaviour, verified 22->23 and 7->8.

weather.tsx:92-108 chimeFor: `fresh` = new-to-seen-set AND Severe|Extreme; then `allowed` filters out Severe when quiet-now. Extreme still chimes during quiet hours (matches spec 'only EXTREME alerts chime, Severe suppressed'). seenRef is populated for ALL list items (line 97), so a toggled-off then toggled-on chime doesn't re-fire old alerts. firstRef seeded silently on first load. Correct.

weather.tsx:139-160 Second-location loader mirrors primary: fetchIdRef-like guard not present here but chimeFor uses independent seen2Ref/first2Ref so races between primary and second are isolated. useEffect resets firstRef and seenRef whenever lat/lon changes.

weather.tsx:162-173 onZip2 debounces validation (strips non-digits, slices to 5) and only geocodes at exact length 5; clears lat/lon/city/state at length 0 so 'Add a second town' fallback re-renders. Toast on geocode failure. Robust.

matrix.tsx:52 Settings.weather adds quietHours + secondLocation with sensible defaults (22->7 window, empty ZIP). DEFAULT_SETTINGS mirrors. Hydration merges via {...DEFAULT_SETTINGS.weather, ...(saved.weather ?? {})} so pre-existing users get new fields defaulted safely without wiping their alertSound/severity/etc.
matrix.tsx:317-343 updateQuietHours and updateSecondLocation both use the (patch) pattern with nested spread, then persist(next). No livePush — intentional, these are phone-side features.

weather.ts:44-86 activeAlerts unchanged: AbortController 8s timeout, dedup by event|area, sort by SEV_RANK. Used by both primary and secondary locations; independent state prevents cross-contamination.

AlertDetailModal is a single instance at the ScrollView root (weather.tsx:400); both the primary alert cards (:218-236) and the second-location cards (:339-355) call setDetail(a) so they share the same modal. Correct DRY approach.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://smart-matrix-hub.preview.emergentagent.com (viewport 390x844). Still no testIDs. Key selector tips: (a) There are exactly 7 role=switch elements across the app when Weather tab is scrolled through - identify the target by clicking the nearest-y switch after scrollIntoView of the label; (b) HourStepper minus/plus are 36x36 Pressables at kids[0] and kids[2] of the .stepperControls container — use container.nextElementSibling.children rects instead of guessing coordinates; (c) 'Tap for details ›' count increases from 1 (primary only) to N+1 (primary + N second-location alerts, capped at 4) — the LAST occurrence is the last second-location card; (d) localStorage key 'aura_settings_v1', new fields: weather.quietHours {enabled, startHour, endHour} and weather.secondLocation {zip, lat, lon, city, state}; (e) Audio chime (expo-audio) does not fire in web preview by design; (f) NWS api.weather.gov is CORS-enabled and typically <3s; Houston 77002 is a reliable fixture for alerts-present; SF 94103 for clear-state.
